title: Arriving at a sacrifice pit
description: A Temple level loads with the message "I CAN HEAR PRAYERS TO KALI!" The player walks left from the entrance to the top of the sacrifice pit, where a damsel and a golden idol stand side by side on four skull blocks, and stops beside the idol.
